title: Purification of total RNA from liquid samples
author: Atsuko Mizoguchi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vu3e6yn

steps.title: Prepare RNA Extraction Mixture
steps.instruction: Add 900 μl of 3D-Gene RNA extraction reagent (Toray Industries, Inc., Kanagawa, Japan) from a liquid sample kit to a 1.7ml centrifuge tube containing 300ul of cultured supernatant and exosome.

steps.title: Homogenize and Incubate
steps.instruction: Homogenize the mixture and incubate at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on the benchtop at 25 °C for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate to separate phases.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 min at 12,000 x g at 4°C without brakes.
Allow the centrifuge to heat up to room temperature after the run.

steps.title: Collect Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 300ul of the upper aqueous phase into a new collection tube.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add 450ul of 100% ethanol to the collected aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down several times.

steps.title: Purify RNA via Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the 750ul of sample into a silica-based membrane column and perform purification following the general nucleic acid purification protocol.

steps.title: Elute and Concentrate RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA using RNase free water and concentrate the final volume to 4ul.
